paragraphs: This material is published by Parshwanath Capital Ventures Fund, a Category III Alternative Investment Fund registered with the Securities and Exchange Board of India (SEBI) under the SEBI (Alternative Investment Funds) Regulations, 2012, Registration No. IN/AIF3/25-26/2108. It does not constitute an offer, invitation, solicitation or recommendation to buy, sell, subscribe to or bid for any security, and it is not investment advice within the meaning of the SEBI (Investment Advisers) Regulations, 2013 or a research report within the meaning of the SEBI (Research Analysts) Regulations, 2014. Calls such as 'Subscribe', 'Neutral', 'Avoid' or 'Screen only' record the Fund's internal analytical view of an offer document and are not a recommendation to any reader.

Units of the Fund are offered only on a private placement basis to eligible investors through the Fund's Private Placement Memorandum, in accordance with the SEBI (Alternative Investment Funds) Regulations, 2012. Nothing in this material is, or should be construed as, a solicitation of investment in the Fund.

The analysis is based on offer documents (DRHP / RHP / prospectus) filed with SEBI and the stock exchanges and on other publicly available information. Figures from sources other than the offer document are identified as such and have not been independently verified. Valuation models, scenarios and projections are illustrative, depend on stated assumptions, and are not forecasts or assurances of future performance. No representation or warranty is given as to accuracy or completeness, and the Fund, its Manager, Sponsor, employees and associates accept no liability for any loss arising from the use of this material.

Disclosure of interest: the Fund, its Manager, Sponsor and their associates may apply for, bid in (including as Anchor Investor or Qualified Institutional Buyer), hold, buy or sell securities of any issuer discussed, before or after publication, and may act in a manner inconsistent with the views expressed here.

Investors should rely on their own examination of the offer document, including its risk factors, and consult their own financial, legal and tax advisers before making any investment decision. Past performance, including of any issuer or lead manager, is not indicative of future results.
